question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"including"** means containing as part of the whole being considered. (जिसमें शामिल है)

 
 
• **Example:** The basic package is $100, **including** tax.
 
 
 
• **"Large-scale"** refers to something that is extensive in size, amount, or intensity. (व्यापक पैमाने पर)
 
 
• **Example:** The company is known for its** large-scale** manufacturing processes.
 
 
 
• The passage talks about various reasons for famines, including large-scale issues such as unemployment due to the import of machine-made goods.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **including large-scale**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Including small-scale** (जिसमें छोटे पैमाने पर शामिल है): Refers to incorporating minor aspects or limited scale.

 
 
• **Example:** The project was completed, including small-scale tasks.
 
 
 
• **Excluding small-scale** (छोटे पैमाने पर बाहर करना): Means not incorporating minor aspects or limited scale.
 
 
• **Example:** The main report focused on overall trends, excluding small-scale details.
 
 
 
• **Excluding large-scale** (व्यापक पैमाने पर बाहर करना): Means not incorporating extensive size, amount, or intensity.
 
 
• **Example:** The survey was specific, excluding large-scale data.
 
 

34:Tc74,
The correct answer is **Option 2.**
